description: Fill an interactive PDF form's text fields, checkboxes, dropdowns, and radios by field name, with an option to flatten the result. Pass inspectOnly to list the fields first.

file.description: PDF as base64, a data URI, or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. 10 MB cap.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

flatten.description: Flatten the form so fields become plain page content.

inspectOnly.description: List the form fields without changing anything.

values.description: Field name to value. Checkboxes take booleans; dropdowns and radios take one of their options.

name: fill_pdf_form
title: Fill a PDF form
